title: Business-Wrap organisation profile
description: Everything about the organisation that a document names and the code must never hard-code. Samples: samples/organisation/*.profile.json (fictional). A real profile lives with the user's documents (or .local/), never in this repository.

entity.description: the organisation's name as a sentence reads it

terms.description: overrides of the pack glossary: customer, request, customerChannel, staffChannel …

codes.description: the document-code table, keyed by the process key or name. The code is looked up here (or in the record), never derived; a missing code stops the build

control.description: control-table values ({ar,en}): preparedBy (a person or team), owner, classification, status, reviewCycle, documentType

maxRows.description: the revisions table keeps the last N rows, this issue included

questionsInDocument.description: print the open questions inside the document (default false: they go to open-questions.md beside it)

backOffice.description: the organisation has a back office whose request-type page states code, fees, directorate, place and validity: those sections may not stay open questions (healer record-present)

codePattern.description: a regular expression every service code must match (e.g. digits only)

readinessDefault.description: readiness printed where a record row states none

rules.description: overrides of the pack's rules settings: maxCount, struckFamilies, backOfficeOnly, derived

reflectWaive.description: areas (requirements, stories, fields, stages, assumptions) where saying less than the earlier document is an accepted correction

pageFill.description: page-fill thresholds on the exported PDF (default 0.8 / 0.4)

fontsAllow.description: font names the export may embed besides the chosen faces

captions.description: action captions by action key, when the system's own buttons are known

customerActors.description: model actor names that are the customer side

threshold.description: an option list this long prints its count only (default 30)

text.description: per-language overrides of any core or pack wording

logos.description: logo files for the theme (see bible/06)
